Setext page
===========

A site page with underlined headings. The underlines
under the title and sections are not content.


First section {#first}
-------------

Text.

---

The `---` above follows a blank line, so it is a horizontal rule, not a heading.

- A list item
---

A `---` under a list item is a rule as well.

| Column | Column |
|--------|--------|
| Cell   | Cell   |
---

So is one under a table.

### An ATX subsection

Mixed with the underlined style.


Second section
--------------

Last words.
